source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban surveillance" OR (surveillance AND (city OR cities) AND (policing OR "public space"))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban surveillance" OR (surveillance AND (city OR cities) AND (policing OR "public space")),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban surveillance" OR ("surveillance" AND ("public space" OR "policing") AND ("cities" OR "city")))
